message.content: I check the tickets, restock the snack shelves, and sweep the lobby. Sometimes I hear a voice, but it doesn’t happen all the time. I try to keep things quiet, like sticking to my routine. I don’t know why it happens, but I guess it’s just part of my life now. I don’t really think about it too much. Work is pretty straightforward. I take the tram every day, eat cereal for breakfast, and then go to the cinema. I live with my sister, and she’s the one who suggested I come here. I don’t know much about medical terms, but I trust her.
